title: PluginAuditorReport
description: Schema for plugin seam and mirror audit report outputs.

target_dir.description: Resolved absolute or relative path to the audited directory.

dag_valid.description: Whether the IoC dependency DAG is free of cycles and dangling requirements.

mirror_discrepancies.description: Count of documentation-to-code signature mismatches or missing tools.

fuzz_safe.description: Count of safe or expected error invocations under adversarial parameter fuzzing.

fuzz_timeouts.description: Count of execution timeouts or potential deadlocks (>5.0s).

fuzz_unhandled.description: Count of unexpected runtime exceptions encountered during fuzzing.
